FOOD.label: Food
FOOD.title: Food products
FOOD.text: We supply food products for households as well as restaurants, lounges, fast-food outlets and other food-service businesses. We value choice, quality and reliable supply, and work to meet our partners’ everyday needs. Our share of the total canned food market is 30%.

BEAUTY.label: Beauty and hygiene
BEAUTY.title: Beauty and hygiene products
BEAUTY.text: We have brought more than 10 international beauty, oral care and hygiene brands to the Mongolian market, and we keep growing our range to match consumers’ everyday needs and preferences.

HOUSEHOLD.label: Household
HOUSEHOLD.title: Household products
HOUSEHOLD.text: We supply household products for the everyday needs of families and organisations. We value the right choice for customers, reliable supply and lasting partnerships.

ceo.title: Message from the CEO
ceo.quote: We believe that business success is measured not only by numerical growth, but by creating real value in our consumers' lives and keeping our partners' trust over the long term.
ceo.body1: Our journey, which began in 1993, has grown into a complete operation that brings leading international food and household brands to consumers in Mongolia. Building on our skilled team, standards-compliant logistics and wide distribution network, we fully ensure product quality and safety and strive to steadily strengthen our partner brands' position in the market.
ceo.body2: I would like to express my deep gratitude to all our partners, customers and colleagues who value lasting cooperation, place their trust in us and grow together with us.
ceo.name: Yaasim Maigul

intro.title: Creating <highlight>value in everyday life</highlight>
intro.lead: Cosmo Trade is an experienced team of more than 150 skilled professionals across 7 specialised departments.
intro.body: We operate a dedicated 3,500-square-metre warehouse and distribution centre for food and household goods that meets international standards and fully ensures product quality and safety. From there we deliver our products quickly to 4,500 outlets across Ulaanbaatar and to more than 3,000 shopping centres in towns and settlements across all 21 provinces.
intro.imageAlt: Cosmo Trade head office and warehouse from above
